WWK4 RGB Wheel Well LED Light Kit – 4 Strings with total 12 LED Pods, 10A Max, App & Remote, Waterproof, Easy Mount, for Trucks, Jeeps, ATVs & UTVs, Multi-Color Underbody Lighting
products.shortDescription:
Complete 4-S tring , 1 2 -Pod Lighting Kit  – Includes  four RGB LED stri ngs with a total of  1 2  bright LED pods  to deliver vibrant, even illumination around your entire wheel well and undercarriage for a striking visual effect.

 IP67 Waterproof & Built for Tough Terrain  – Every component – from the LED pods and controller to all wire connectors – is  sealed to IP67 standards , ensuring complete protection against water, mud, and dust. Designed to thrive in the harshest off-road and all-terrain environments.

 Smartphone & Remote Contro l – Control your lights wirelessly via the free “EZ RGB” app (iOS/Android) or the included RF remote. Adjust colors, brightness, effects, and timers right from your phone or with the click of a button.

 Dynamic Lighting Modes  – Choose from solid colors, dynamic effects, music sync via built-in microphone, and timer functions for automatic shutoff.

 Strong Connectivity  – Reliable wireless control up to 35+ feet, even in challenging environments. No signal dropout when you need it most.

products.title: RIK10 True Spec 10 Gauge 2-Channel Amplifier Wiring Kit – CCA Power & Ground Wire, OFC RCA Cable, Mini-ANL Fuse – Ideal for Powered Subwoofer Installation
products.shortDescription:
About this item: 

 Complete 2-Channel Amp Kit for Powered Subwoofers  – Includes everything you need to install a powered subwoofer or small amplifier: 10 Gauge CCA power/ground wire, OFC RCA cable, remote wire, and mini-ANL fuse holder.

 OFC RCA Cable for Clean Signal  – 17ft oxygen-free copper helical twisted 2-channel RCA interconnect ensures noise rejection and superior audio quality from head unit to subwoofer.

 10 Gauge CCA Power & Ground Wire  – Premium frosted blue (power) and black (ground) 10 Gauge CCA wire with pre-attached ring terminals for reliable current flow to powered subwoofers.

 Complete Protection & Installation Accessories  – Includes a mini-ANL fuse holder with fuse, rubber firewall grommet, butt connector, zip ties, and nickel-plated ring terminals – safe and professional installation.

 Perfect for Powered Subwoofer Upgrades  – Specifically sized and configured for compact active subwoofers and entry-level 2-channel amps; save time and money with a tailored kit.

CANL400-1 2PCS 400A ANL Fuse, Ceramic Housing High Heat Resistant, High Insulation, Heavy Duty for 12V-32V Car Audio, Solar, Marine, RV Battery & Amplifier Circuit Protection
products.shortDescription:
Premium Ceramic Housing – Not Standard Plastic – Unlike ordinary ANL fuses with Bakelite housings, the RECOIL CANL series features a high-temperature resistant ceramic casing. Ceramic provides superior heat dissipation, higher insulation resistance, and will not deform or melt under extreme current loads – ideal for high-amperage applications.

Extreme Heat Resistance for High Current Protection – Designed specifically for high-power systems where standard fuses fail. Ceramic construction withstands significantly higher temperatures than Bakelite ANL fuses, ensuring reliable protection during sustained high-current operation. Perfect for competition-grade car audio, heavy-duty solar arrays, and marine systems.

High Insulation Performance – Ceramic material offers excellent dielectric strength, reducing the risk of arc flash and electrical leakage. Provides an extra layer of safety for your valuable electronics – amplifiers, batteries, controllers, and wiring.

Precise Amperage Rating – Multiple Options Available – Available in 150A, 200A, 250A, 300A, and 400A ratings (sold in 2 pieces). Each fuse is clearly marked for easy identification. Choose the correct rating for your system's maximum current draw to protect against short circuits and overloads. Two pieces pack – use one for the rating you need, keep one for replacement.

Universal Compatibility – 12V to 32V Systems – Works with standard ANL fuse holders (sold separately). Compatible with 12V, 24V, and 37V DC electrical systems – ideal for car audio amplifiers, solar panel arrays, battery banks, marine electronics, RV power centers, and off-grid power systems.

Reliable Circuit Protection – Protects your amplifier, controller, wires, and battery from dangerous overcurrent conditions. When a short circuit or overload occurs, the fuse blows instantly to prevent equipment damage, fire hazards, and electrical failure.

Standard ANL Size – Easy Replacement – Industry standard ANL dimensions, making it a direct replacement for any standard ANL fuse. No modifications needed.

products.description:
Recoil engineered the RED1800.1 Class D mono-block subwoofer amplifier to be dominant in both power and reliability. The RED1800.1D is 1-Ohm stable and utilizes a wide array of premium components that make it extremely powerful and reliable – such as its high-speed MOSFET power supply and advanced PCB board layout—conservatively rated at 1800 watts RMS power at a 1-ohm load.

 Especially, this mono amp is strappable (bridgeable). Strapping will give you twice the power and double the impedance load compared to having one single amplifier. If you have a 1,800w amplifier at 1 ohm, and you strap it with an identical amplifier at 1 ohm, you’ll have 3,600w at 2 ohm. Each amp will still be responsible for handling its own 1,800w at 1ohm, but together they’re sending out twice as much energy.

 Furthermore, the oversized 1/0 gauge power and ground terminals on the amplifier allow maximum current flow. You'll have full reign over your amplifier with the built-in user control panel, featuring a bass EQ, and variable adjustment tunings for gain level, low-pass filter, and subsonic filter.

 In addition to the above features, this model also features 4-way protection circuitry, including electrical shortage, overheating, low voltage, and more.

 Why do you need car audio capacitors? 

 A loud and bassy car audio system is great, but it can also hinder other parts of your vehicle. An overpowered amplifier can drain the juice from your battery, dim the car’s lights, or strain the alternator. To help alleviate any issues or potential damage, you should hook up a high-quality Recoil power capacitor. It works like a smaller version of your battery and stores energy to be used for other electronic components, such as the amplifier.

products.description:
The World’s smallest 4-channelmicro speaker cable to RCA line output converter. Use MLOC4 when adding an amplifier to a factory radio to convert the radio’s speaker level output to the low amplifier (RCA) level input

 Takes as much as 80 Wattsof input signal and delivers up to 10 volts of output. Flat 20Hz-20kHz frequency range at all volume levels

 Features 60 Ohm Loads to ensure uninterrupted audio playback when used with most OEM smart radio.

 The speaker wire is made of 99.99% oxygen free copper for superior bass response and signal clarity.

 Provides 12-volt for amplifier remote turn on with LED indicator.

 Super compact design allows for easy installation.
products.shortDescription:
Introduction:

Add an amplifier to nearly any radio with Recoil MLOC4 Stereo Line-Out Converter. Experience true sonic accuracy at any volume level with all the sparkling highs and thunderous lows of your original audio. Unlike traditional LOCs the MLOC4 is designed without inductors to deliver a completely flat 20Hz-20kHz frequency response at all volume levels. Using nothing more than your factory speaker wires the innovative MLOC4 automatically converts the speaker signal into both an RCA signal and a powerful 100 milli-amp 12-volt remote wire using DC offset. Powerful enough to turn on multiple amplifiers the 12-volt remote wire delivers plenty of power without hunting for a switched 12-volt power source. Accepts up to 80 watts (20 volts) of input signal and delivers up to an 10-volt output signal.

 Why do I need a smart LOC?

Today’s modern OEM smart radios have incorporated a protection circuit that will shut off or distort audio on one or more channels if the load on the OEM radio is not within a specific impedance range. This Recoil smart LOC features 60 Ohm load which is fully compatible with standard radios and most smart radios.

products.description:

products.shortDescription:
It becomes more difficult to find the space for the bass you need. Recoil offers a compact passive subwoofer enclosure that fits into the hub of your spare tire to give you maximum bass and maximum space saving.

 This hidden subwoofer offers super easy installation and out of sight bass solution. It is designed to handle 350W RMS and 700W Peak power. The 12" feather-light fiberglass IMPP woofer cone with butyl rubber surround delivers the signature kick and punch of bass.

  

 Recoil hidden 12” passive spare tire subwoofer drops into the spare tire in a vehicle. With its quick release feature, the sub can be easily removed when you need to access the tire.

 It features a 12” subwoofer to deliver deep and powerful bass, with power handling up to 700 watts. The bass transmits cleanly and evenly throughout the vehicle without any vibrations or unwanted noises.

 The 12" feather-light fiberglass IMPP woofer cone with butyl rubber surround delivers the signature kick and punch of bass. The subwoofer’s dual 4-ohm voice coils give you the flexibility of choosing 2 or 8-ohm total impedance.

 The rugged cast-aluminum enclosure protects the sub from your cargo while taking up very little space.

 Installation Note: Recoil PST12 is designed to mount inside the spare tire rim. You'll need to turn your spare tire upside down to install this sub. It should only be used in vehicles that have the spare tire inside the vehicle and feature a removable spare tire post; not compatible with welded spare tire posts.

products.title: PBG3-4 True Spec 4 Gauge 99.99% Oxygen Free Copper Wire Big 3 Amp Wiring Upgrade Kits for Car Audio Systems up to 200 Amps
products.description:
The Big 3 Upgrade 

 If you're a car audio enthusiast, eventually your sound system will reach the point where it is too powerful for your vehicle's existing electrical system. The first step in upgrading your power system should be a Big 3 Upgrade, and there is no better Big 3 kit than Recoil PBG3 & PBG3-4. Our Big 3 Upgrade kit is specifically designed to help your old electrical system cope with the demands of your fantastic sound system and help with those annoying dimming headlights when your sound really kicks. Our kits are engineered from the highest quality materials to ensure long lasting durability. Included with the kit are the battery ground to chassis wire, the chassis to engine block wire and the alternator positive to battery positive wire as well as the clamps, screws and copper ring terminals necessary with this installation. The highly conducive 99.99% Oxygen Free Copper wire provides optimal performance in even the harshest environments. It allows your electrical system to run at its maximum efficiency while also allowing your amps to run cooler and subs to hit harder.

  

  

 Flexibility 

 Recoil stranded wire is extremely tolerant of the rough conditions in vehicles and compensates for vibration, heat expansion and flexibility. This flexible but well shielded wire is crucial for getting through all of the nooks and passage ways within the cramped confines of vehicle interiors.

  

 Cable Thickness 

 The thickness of the actual wire, not the insulation, is critical when it comes to transferring the extraordinary current of your electrical system. With hundreds of strands of wire in one cable you get an increased current flow and a higher amperage carrying capacity with a reduced cable size.

  

 Insulation Material 

 Recoil insulation hinders electric current from exiting the wire prematurely which prevents electrocution and damage to components within the vehicle. Additionally, the insulation maintains the flexibility of the wire while preventing corrosion and damage in the hostile vehicle environment.

products.description:
寻找真正的 8 号无氧铜放大器接线套件？Recoil 自豪地推出 PCK8 和 PCK84 8 号放大器接线安装套件。该软件包包括您需要的一切，包括 RCA 电缆和扬声器线，让您的 amp 正确通电并以最高效率运行。

 Recoil 选择在整个套件中使用优质材料，包括真正的无氧铜电源、接地、RCA 和扬声器线。这种全铜线有助于防止整个音频系统的信号和功率损失，让您的放大器和组件充分运行。超耐用且灵活的外护套使电缆的安装和布线变得轻而易举。

 Recoil 的卓越品质和材料也体现在随附的配件中。实心黄铜和缎面镀铬 Mini-ANL 保险丝座，带有 80 安培 Mini-ANL 保险丝，可保护您免受代价高昂的电涌或接地问题的影响。电源线包裹在 6 英尺耐用的尼龙编织管中，以保护其免受发动机舱的热量和擦伤。即使是简单的安装附件，如铲形连接器，也经过镀镍处理，具有出色的长期耐用性和信号传输能力。

  

 灵活性

 反冲绞合线对车辆的恶劣条件具有极强的耐受性，并可补偿振动、热膨胀和柔韧性。这种柔韧但屏蔽良好的电线对于穿过车辆内部狭窄范围内的所有角落和通道至关重要。

 电缆厚度

 在传输音频系统的非凡电流时，实际电线的厚度（而不是绝缘层）至关重要。在一根电缆中插入数百股电线时，您可以获得更大的电流和更高的电流承载能力，同时减小电缆尺寸。

 绝缘材料

 反冲绝缘可防止电流过早离开电线，从而防止触电和损坏车辆内的部件。此外，绝缘材料保持了电线的柔韧性，同时防止在恶劣的车辆环境中腐蚀和损坏。

products.title: SCHK Dash Camera Acc Hardwire Kit Mini-USB, 24H Parking Monitor Mode, Converts 12-24V to Output 5V/2.5A, Low Voltage Protection, 14ft with Fuse Tap Kit
products.description:
Introduction: 

 Recoil dash camera hardwire kit is a device to power your dashcam from vehicle fuse box. It keeps your dashcam continuously running with 24-hour Parking Monitor Mode. It is compatible with most dash cameras available in the market with a mini USB connector. 

 This Hardwire Kit monitors your voltage and cut-off power if the voltage drops below the conﬁgured Volts more than 8 seconds to reserve enough power for your vehicle. You have four conﬁguration volts to select as below:

 Low Voltage Protection: 

 For 12V Battery: 11.6V 11.9V 12.2V 12.5V

 For 24V Battery: 23.6V 23.9V 24.2V 24.5V   

 Protections: 

 Reverse Connect Protection

 Short Circuit Protection

 Overload Protection

 Overtemperature Protection (Enters into protection over 130℃. Back to work below 90℃).

 Cable Length: 4.5 Meters (14ft)

 Connector: Mini USB, DC 5V, 2.5A

 Working temperature: -20℃to 90℃

 Wiring: 

 Red Wire (BAT+) – Connect with fuse box, which can provide power to dashcam even when the vehicle is off.

 Yellow Wire (ACC) – Connect with ACC, which makes the dashcam automatically power On & Off when the vehicle is turned on or off.

 Black Wire (GND) – Connect with metal bolt or screw for grounding.
products.shortDescription:
Recoil ACC Mini-USB Dash Camera Hardwire Kit – This allows the Dash Cam to be installed in your vehicle without the need to use the 12V/24V outlet (car cigarette socket). Converts 12V-24V to Output 5V/2.5A

 24H Parking Mode – With the Hardwire Kit being installed, the Dash Cam will power on and start recording automatically when the vehicle is opened or starts. If you turn on the function of parking monitor on the dash cam, it will automatically enter the time-lapse recording mode or the continuous recording mode.

 Low Voltage Protection – The built-in voltage limiter will protect the vehicle's battery from going flat. If the voltage of your car battery drops to this default voltage 11.8V or 23.6V, it will cut off the power, which leaves you with enough power to start your vehicle for the next time.

 Complete Accessories Pack – Include all the parts you need for installation. Simply plug the required fuse tap into the vehicle’s fuse box to provide the camera with its own power supply.

 Fuse sizes and the type of Fuse Taps vary depending on your vehicle, please check your fuse box to see what type of fuse tap your vehicle required. There are 4 fuse taps included: ACZ(micro2), ACS(mini), ACN(LP-mini) and ACU(ATO).

products.title: MLOC2 2-Channel Smart Micro Line Output Converter with 10V Output and 12V Remote Turn-On Trigger and 60 Ohm Load Impedance
products.description:
Add an amplifier to nearly any radio with Recoil MLOC2 Stereo Line-Out Converter. Experience true sonic accuracy at any volume level with all the sparkling highs and thunderous lows of your original audio. Unlike traditional LOCs the MLOC2 is designed without inductors to deliver a completely flat 20Hz-20kHz frequency response at all volume levels. Using nothing more than your factory speaker wires the innovative MLOC2 automatically converts the speaker signal into both an RCA signal and a powerful 100 milli-amp 12-volt remote wire using DC offset. Powerful enough to turn on multiple amplifiers the 12-volt remote wire delivers plenty of power without hunting for a switched 12-volt power source. Accepts up to 80 watts (20 volts) of the input signal and delivers up to an 10-volt output signal.

 Why do I need a smart LOC?

Today’s modern OEM smart radios have incorporated a protection circuit that will shut off or distort audio on one or more channels if the load on the OEM radio is not within a specific impedance range. This Recoil smart LOC features 60 Ohm load which is fully compatible with standard radios and most smart radios.
products.shortDescription:
The World’s smallest 2-channel micro speaker cable to RCA line output converter. Use MLOC2 when adding an amplifier to a factory radio to convert the radio’s speaker level output to the low amplifier (RCA) level input

Takes as much as 80 Watts of the input signal and delivers up to 10 volts of output. Flat 20Hz-20kHz frequency range at all volume levels

Features 60 Ohm Loads to ensure uninterrupted audio playback when used with most OEM smart radios.

The speaker wire is made of 99.99% oxygen-free copper for superior bass response and signal clarity.

Provides 12-volt for amplifier remote turn on with LED indicator.

Super compact design allows for easy installation.

products.title: PW6-125 Premium True Spec 6 Gauge Power Wire, 99.9% Oxygen-Free Pure Copper , Flexible Soft Touch Red PVC Jacket (125 Feet/Spool)
products.description:
125 feet of 6 AWG, 1176 strands of 99.99% Oxygen-Free pure copper wire

Pure oxygen-free copper material helps prevent power loss through the entire audio system, allowing your amplifier and components to operate to their fullest.

Super flexible soft touch red PVC jacket for fast and easy installation

Comes with our patented modular wire spool and rack system. These spools and racks can be assembled vertically or horizontally. You can assemble them to fit into a tight corner, put them on the shelf, build a merchandising display rack, or put them on a slat wall.

The spools are designed with bearings. It is easy to slide them in & out of the slots on the rack. And you can pull or roll the wire smoothly and quietly.
products.shortDescription:
Recoil Premium Power/Ground Wire 

 Looking for true oxygen-free copper power & ground wires? Recoil is proud to introduce our premium Echo PRO spool wires.

 Recoil chose to utilize top-quality materials. This full copper wire helps prevent power loss through the entire audio system, allowing your amplifier and components to operate to their fullest. The ultra-durable and flexible outer jacket makes installation and routing of the cable a breeze.

 Recoil-stranded wire is extremely tolerant of the rough conditions in vehicles and compensates for vibration, heat expansion, and flexibility.

 The thickness of the actual wire, not the insulation, is critical when it comes to transferring the extraordinary current of your audio system. With hundreds of strands of wire in one cable, you get an increased current flow and a higher amperage carrying capacity.

 Additionally, the insulation maintains the flexibility of the wire while preventing corrosion and damage in a hostile vehicle environment.

products.title: SRL500 Microprocessor Controlled 500A Smart Battery Isolator and High Current Starter Relay, Dual Sensing Smart Relay, with Ring Terminals
products.description:
SRL500 handles 500 Amps continuous at 12V and 700 Amps Surge.

 Eliminates multiple battery drain as it stops the battery bank from getting power from each one and extends battery life. It prevents the equipment from discharging the main battery when it is operated while the engine is off.

 Microprocessor-controlled smart relay does not create a voltage drop to the second battery like a conventional isolator.

 Once the main battery reaches 13.2V, the smart relay connects two batteries. Once the system drops below 12.7V, it disconnects two batteries.

 The dual sensing feature allows charging both ways if the auxiliary battery is charged by the external power source.

 A waterproof manual override switch allows you to connect two batteries with the push of a button for 60 seconds.

 Excellent waterproof performance, high quality in any weather conditions. Two 1/0AWG copper ring terminals and heat shrink tubing are included for easy installation.

products.title: PPK4D True 4 Gauge 99.99% Oxygen Free Copper Car Audio Dual Amplifier Power Installation Wiring Kits
products.description:
Recoil  Premium OFC Kits Introduction 

  

 Are you looking for true-spec oxygen-free copper amp wiring kits? Recoil is proud to introduce the PPK0, PPK4 & PPK8 0 Gauge Power Installation Kits. These kits include everything you need, including power wire, ground wire, and fuse-holders, to get your amp powered up properly and running at its peak efficiency.

  

 Recoil chose to utilize top-quality materials throughout the kit, including true oxygen-free copper power, ground, remote turn-on wire, and fuse-holders. This full copper wire helps prevent signal and power loss through the entire audio system, allowing your amplifier and components to operate to their fullest. The ultra-durable and flexible outer jacket makes installation and routing of the cable a breeze.

  

 The superior quality and materials of Recoil also show in the included accessories. The solid brass and satin chrome plated ANL/Mini-ANL Fuse-holders with fuses, protect you from costly power surges or grounding issues. The power wire comes wrapped in 6 feet of durable nylon braided tubing to protect it from heat and chafing in the engine bay. Even simple installation accessories such as the spade connectors are nickel plated for superior long-term durability and signal transfer.

  

 Flexibility 

 Recoil stranded wire is extremely tolerant of the rough conditions in vehicles and compensates for vibration, heat expansion, and flexibility. This flexible but well-shielded wire is crucial for getting through all of the nooks and passageways within the cramped confines of vehicle interiors.

  

 Cable Thickness 

 The thickness of the actual wire, not the insulation, is critical when it comes to transferring the extraordinary current of your audio system. With hundreds of strands of wire in one cable, you get an increased current flow and a higher amperage carrying capacity with a reduced cable size.

  

 Insulation Material 

 Recoil insulation prevents electric current from exiting the wire prematurely, preventing electrocution and damage to components within the vehicle. Additionally, the insulation maintains the flexibility of the wire while preventing corrosion and damage in a hostile vehicle environment.

products.title: AF6 6-Way ATC/ATO Fuse Block, 6-Circuit Power Block for Car RV Truck Boat UTV/ATV, Bolt Terminals, 12pcs Fuses, Screws, Fuse Tool & Sticker Labels
products.description:
Recoil fuse block offers a space-saving and cost-effective solution to adding circuit protection. This 6-way ATC/ATO fuse block allows you to supply power to your new accessories without compromising your stock wiring. It is perfect for cleaning up the wiring on your car, truck, boat, or any vehicle. It comes with 6 fuse-protected terminals for up to 100 amps of power, and tin-plated copper components for improved conductivity and corrosion resistance.

 6-circuit fuse block accepts ATO® and ATC® fast acting blade fuses.

Tin-plated copper buses and fuse clips for maximum power transfer

Positive distribution bus with #10-32 studs

Accepts ring or snap fork-type terminals

The polycarbonate cover incorporates an easy-to-open push button latch providing easy access to fuses

12cps fuses, two spare screws, and a fuse tool are included for easy replacement in the field, including circuit sticker labels

 What's Included?

 (1) 6-Way Fuse Box

(4) 20A Fuses (4) 15A Fuses (2) 10A Fuses (2) 5A Fuses

(2) #10 Spare Screws

(1) Fuse Clamp Tool

(1) Pack of Label Stickers

(4) Stainless Steel Screws

products.title: SPB8 Foldable Silicone Speaker Baffle Kits for 8" Speakers
products.shortDescription:
Recoil’s patented foldable silicone speaker baffle kits are designed to improve the directional flow of sound waves and focus them into the cabin. It perfectly seals the speaker against the interior panel.  The egg crate captures the back wave reflections of the speaker. It also offers waterproof protection for speakers. The foldable ring fits different speakers’ installation depth. Recoil patented silicone speaker baffles (US Patent 10,582,296) create a tight and secure seal around your speakers. The soft silicone reduces panel-to-frame and door panel reverberation and road noise for optimal sound quality. The front ring is foldable to guide the sound wave into the vehicle cabin. 

 The egg crate foam helps create a barrier between the speaker and the metal door, it improves sound by preventing sound waves from bouncing back. Our baffle offers to drop water protection to the speaker if folded out. The bottom half can be folded twice or trimmed for simple customization to match the proper mounting depth, as to not change the audio performance of the speaker. A lot of doors have water leaks between the window and the door gasket.

 Recoil baffles are engineered with high-quality silicone which lasts a lifetime. The silicone material is much more durable and eco-friendlier than foam and EVA baffle, gasket, or ring These baffles are available in most car speaker sizes including 8". Our silicone baffle rings are the most simple accessories you can install to make your speakers sound amazing.

products.title: PCK44 Premium OFC 4AWG 4-Channel Complete Amp Installation Kit
products.description:
Recoil Premium OFC Kits Introduction 

 Looking for a true 4-gauge oxygen-free copper amp wiring kit? Recoil is proud to introduce the PCK4 4 Gauge Amplifier Wiring Installation Kit. This package includes everything you need, including RCA cable and speaker wire, to get your amp powered up properly and running at its peak efficiency.

 Recoil chose to utilize top-quality materials throughout the kit, including true oxygen-free copper power, ground, RCA, and speaker wire. This full copper wire helps prevent signal and power loss through the entire audio system, allowing your amplifier and components to operate to their fullest. The ultra-durable and flexible outer jacket makes the installation and routing of the cable a breeze.

 The superior quality and materials of Recoil are also shown in the included accessories. The solid brass and satin chrome-plated ANL/Mini-ANL Fuse holder with 80/100/120-amp ANL fuses, protects you from costly power surges or grounding issues. The power wire comes wrapped in 6 feet of durable nylon braided tubing to protect it from heat and chafing in the engine bay. Even simple installation accessories such as the spade connectors are nickel-plated for superior long-term durability and signal transfer.

 Flexibility 

The Recoil-stranded wire is extremely tolerant of the rough conditions in vehicles and compensates for vibration, heat expansion, and flexibility. This flexible but well-shielded wire is crucial for getting through all of the nooks and passageways within the cramped confines of vehicle interiors.

 Cable Thickness 

The thickness of the actual wire, not the insulation, is critical when it comes to transferring the extraordinary current of your audio system. With hundreds of strands of wire in one cable, you get an increased current flow and a higher amperage carrying capacity with a reduced cable size.

 Insulation Material 

Recoil insulation hinders electric current from exiting the wire prematurely which prevents electrocution and damage to components within the vehicle. Additionally, the insulation maintains the flexibility of the wire while preventing corrosion and damage in the hostile vehicle environment.

products.description:
• Recoil SL1708 8” Under Seat Slim Amplified Car Subwoofer. 500 Watts Peak / 120 Watts RMS. 

• Special wheel shape and super shallow design with only 3.1” height fits anywhere in your vehicle. You can fit it under seat or in your trunk. 

• The subwoofer housing is made of solid die-cat aluminum with heavy duty mounting brackets. 

• Low Level RCA Input. Use RCA interconnect cable to link the SL1708 with any aftermarket source unit. High Level Inputs with Auto Turn-On Technology. It will be used to connect SL1708 to your factory OEM radio. 

• Adjustable Input Sensitivity. Soft Delayed Remote Turn-On. Thermal Protection Circuit, Short Protection Circuit. 

• Blue Power/Red Protect LED Indicator. Phase Switch: 0° or 180°. Low Pass Filter: 40Hz – 150Hz. Bass Boost: 0 – 12dB @ 50Hz. Subwoofer Level Remote Control Included. 

• Super Compact Dimensions: 9.6” x 3.1” (245 x 80mm) 

  

 Specifications: 

 

• Peak Power Handling: 500 Watts 

• RMS Power Handling: 120 Watts 

• PWM MOSFET Power Supply 

• Low Level RCA Input 

• High Level Inputs with Auto Turn-On Technology 

• Adjustable Input Sensitivity 5V-0.1V 

• Soft Delayed Remote Turn-On 

• Thermal Protection Circuit, Short Protection Circuit 

• Overload Protection Circuit 

• Blue Power/Red Protect LED 

• Working Voltage: DC 9V-16V 

• Phase Switch: 0° or 180° 

• Low Pass Filter: 40Hz – 150Hz

• Built in Subsonic Filter @ 20Hz

• Dimensions: 9.6” x 3.1” (245 x 80mm) 

• Subwoofer Level Remote Control Included 

• Heavy Duty Mounting Brackets Included 

• Oxygen Free Copper Wiring Kit Included
products.shortDescription:
Recoil SL1708 is a high end under seat enclosure designed to bring exceptional bass to any vehicle with limited space. This impressive new design features a high performance 8″ subwoofer internally powered by an efficient amplifier engineered to play hard in tight spaces.

 Unlike other rectangular subwoofers, Recoil SL1708 is designed with round shape, plus its 3.1” micro-thin super shallow design, it slides under all the seats and works well behind truck seats or in small trunks where space is at a premium.

 SL1708 comes with plug-n-play wiring kit and mounting brackets. We truly make the installation a breeze. It accepts both speaker level or RCA level inputs, so you can connect SL1708 with any factory or aftermarket source unit.

 If you are looking for a compact bass solution in your vehicle, then the SL1708 by Recoil is the right product for you!

Our baffle offers to drop water protection to the speaker if folded out. A lot of doors have water leaks between the window and the door gasket.

 Recoil baffles are engineered with high-quality silicone which lasts a lifetime. The silicone material is much more durable and eco-friendlier than foam and EVA baffle, gasket, or ring These baffles are available in most car speaker sizes including 5.25", 6.5", 6×8", 6×9", and even 8". Our silicone baffle rings are the most simple accessories you can install to make your speakers sound amazing.

 Carbon/Electrolytic Hybrid Capacitor Technology 

Electrolytic caps generally have a faster recharge rate but less power in their reserve. Carbon capacitors are the opposite of their electrolytic counterparts. While they are able to hold more power to divert back to the amplifier and the entire audio system, they will not be able to recharge as quickly. Recoil introduces a blend of both electrolytic and carbon capacitors, which have super-fast charge rates but also reserve more power.
products.shortDescription:
Why do you need car audio capacitors? 

A loud and bassy car audio system is great, but it can also hinder other parts of your vehicle. An overpowered amplifier can drain the juice from your battery, dim the car’s lights, or strain the alternator. To help alleviate any issues or potential damage, you should hook up a high-quality Recoil power capacitor. It works like a smaller version of your battery and stores energy to be used for other electronic components, such as the amplifier.

products.title: PCK8 Premium 8AWG Complete Wiring Kits
products.description:
Recoil Premium OFC Kits Introduction 

 Looking for a true 8-gauge oxygen free copper amp wiring kit? Recoil is proud to introduce the PCK8 8 Gauge Amplifier Wiring Installation Kit. This package includes everything you need, including RCA cable and speaker wire, to get your amp powered-up properly and running at its peak efficiency.

 Recoil chose to utilize top-quality materials throughout the kit, including true oxygen-free copper power, ground, RCA and speaker wire. This full copper wire helps prevent signal and power loss through the entire audio system, allowing your amplifier and components to operate to their fullest. The ultra-durable and flexible outer jacket makes installation and routing of the cable a breeze.

 The superior quality and materials of Recoil also shows in the included accessories. The solid brass and satin chrome plated Mini-ANL Fuse holder with a 60 amp Mini-ANL fuse, protecting you from costly power surges or grounding issues. The power wire comes wrapped in 6 feet of durable nylon braided tubing to protect it from heat and chafing in the engine bay. Even simple installation accessories such as the spade connectors are nickel plated for superior long-term durability and signal transfer.

 Flexibility 

Recoil stranded wire is extremely tolerant of the rough conditions in vehicles and compensates for vibration, heat expansion and flexibility. This flexible but well shielded wire is crucial for getting through all of the nooks and passage ways within the cramped confines of vehicle interiors.

 Cable Thickness 

The thickness of the actual wire, not the insulation, is critical when it comes to transferring the extraordinary current of your audio system. With hundreds of strands of wire in one cable you get an increased current flow and a higher amperage carrying capacity with a reduced cable size.

 Insulation Material 

Recoil insulation hinders electric current from exiting the wire prematurely which prevents electrocution and damage to components within the vehicle. Additionally, the insulation maintains the flexibility of the wire while preventing corrosion and damage in the hostile vehicle environment.

products.description:
BOX 

 

• Two 4ft premium true-spec 1/0 AWG Ground Cables with seamless ring terminal 

• One 6ft premium true-spec 1/0 AWG Power Cable with seamless ring terminal 

• Ten black nylon cable clamps 

• Ten 1/2" #8 Wafer Head Tek Screws 

• Ten 8" Black Zip Ties (x 10) 

• Three pieces heavy-duty seamless ring terminals 
 
 The Big 3 Upgrade 

 If you're a car audio enthusiast, eventually your sound system will reach the point where it is too powerful for your vehicle's existing electrical system. The first step in upgrading your power system should be a Big 3 Upgrade, and there is no better Big 3 kit than Recoil PBG3. Our Big 3 Upgrade kit is specifically designed to help your old electrical system cope with the demands of your fantastic sound system and help with those annoying dimming headlights when your sound really kicks. Our kits are engineered from the highest quality materials to ensure long-lasting durability. Included with the kit is the battery ground to chassis wire, the chassis to engine block wire, and the alternator positive to battery positive wire as well as the clamps, screws, and copper ring terminals necessary with this installation. The highly conducive 99.99% Oxygen Free Copper wire provides optimal performance in even the harshest environments. It allows your electrical system to run at its maximum efficiency while also allowing your amps to run cooler and subs to hit harder.

 Flexibility 

 Recoil stranded wire is extremely tolerant of the rough conditions in vehicles and compensates for vibration, heat expansion, and flexibility. This flexible but well-shielded wire is crucial for getting through all of the nooks and passageways within the cramped confines of vehicle interiors.

 Cable Thickness 

 The thickness of the actual wire, not the insulation, is critical when it comes to transferring the extraordinary current of your electrical system. With hundreds of strands of wire in one cable, you get an increased current flow and a higher amperage carrying capacity with a reduced cable size.

 Insulation Material 

 Recoil insulation hinders electric current from exiting the wire prematurely which prevents electrocution and damage to components within the vehicle. Additionally, the insulation maintains the flexibility of the wire while preventing corrosion and damage in the hostile vehicle environment.

products.title: BRL500 - Recoil 500a Battery Isolator with Terminals
products.description:

•

• 
 No voltage drop — eliminates the typical 0.6–0.7V loss associated with standard diode isolators 

• 
 Dual-battery protection — prevents battery banks from cross-draining each other

 Main battery preservation — isolates the starting battery when the engine is off and accessories are running

 Waterproof construction — rated for harsh weather and under-hood environments
